goals.description: Detached run context helper: context.WithoutCancel(reqCtx) plus its own timeout budget, surviving the originating request's cancellation
Per-run Hub: topic per RunID, bounded ring buffer for replay-on-reattach, bounded per-subscriber channel
Slow-subscriber drop: Publish never blocks on a full subscriber channel — drops that subscriber instead
Reattach/disconnect lifecycle: Subscribe returns a replay slice + live channel + idempotent unsubscribe; Hub can Close a run's topic (all subscribers see a closed channel)

Tests covering: basic delivery, replay after a given seq, ring-buffer eviction, slow-subscriber drop without blocking Publish, unsubscribe (incl. double-unsubscribe safety), topic Close, detached context surviving parent cancellation, detached context's own timeout firing. All 10 tests pass under plain go test AND under go test -race
goals.plan_ref: 03-backend-folder-architecture.md §8 testing table ('Concurrency: hub_test.go — -race: cancellation, subscriber drop, lease contention')
goals.resolution_note: Originally blocked: go test -race requires cgo, and this environment had CGO_ENABLED=0 with no C compiler on PATH. Resolved 2026-09-14 by installing a C toolchain (`scoop install gcc`, nuwen mingw-w64 15.2.0) and rerunning with CGO_ENABLED=1. `go test -race ./internal/pipeline/...` and `go test -race ./...` (full module) both pass with zero races reported, including TestHub_ConcurrentPublishSubscribe and the three RunContext concurrency tests.
